subject: [AMBER] What does ivalence set in PBSA?

messages.author: Matthew Guberman-Pfeffer
messages.body:
Dear Amber community,
The ivalence keyword is used in Section 6.3.5 to compare Delphi to PBSA results, but I cannot find where the meaning of ivalence is explained. Can someone please describe (or point to a description) of this keyword?
Best,
Matthew
